sections.what_can_be_symptoms_of_genital_herpes:
Swelling in lymph nodes. 
 Headache. 
 Fever. 
 Muscle aches. 
 Pain in the genital areas. 
 Sores can form on cervix, external genitals and vaginal areas in females. 
 Sores formation occurs on the scrotum, penis, thighs and urethra in males. 
 In the case of both male and females, Sores can form on the anus, mouth and buttocks.
sections.causes_associated_with_genital_herpes:
There are two type of herpes simplex virus which is responsible for genital herpes:- 

 HSV -1 – In herpes simplex virus (HSV-1) there is the formation of cold sores, fever blisters around mouth and can spread to genital areas due to oral sex. These infections are less common than HSV -2. 
 HSV -2 – Herpes simplex virus -2 is the most common cause of genital herpes. In this case viral infection spreads through sexual contact and through skin to skin contact. HSV -2 is a highly contagious virus. 

 Virus cannot survive outside the body and it die quickly. It is impossible to get infected by using the towels, toilets and other things used by the infected people. 
 Ayurvedic View 
 In Ayurveda there are three energies – vata, pitta and kapha which are liable for the good health. When there is an imbalance in any of the three energies it results in the health complications. Genital herpes is due to the herpes simplex virus (HSV-1) (HSV -2). In this infection there is the vitiation of all the three doshas in the body. There are various factors which are responsible for this condition like poor lifestyle and improper eating habits.
